This Memorial Day, we honor and remember the brave servicemen and servicewomen who made the ultimate sacrifice to protect our nation and our freedom. 

We remain grateful for the courage, service, and sacrifice of our fallen heroes, and we are forever indebted to them.

Our best moment of the Indy 500 yesterday was when nearly 400,000 Americans at the world’s largest single-day sporting event went completely silent for the playing of Taps. 

Our country never takes for granted the profound sacrifices that have been made in the defense of freedom. #MemorialDay

We had a great time today at the 110th INDY 500, and enjoyed catching part of the race on the rooftop with the legendary Roger Penske. Team Penske driver David Malukas finished 2nd today, and just 0.0233 seconds behind winner Felix Rosenqvist—the closest finish in race history! 

The best part was the moving experience of honoring our fallen heroes for Memorial Day with nearly 400,000 Americans.🇺🇸
